defs.def: a unit for measuring how much energy food will produce 大卡，千卡，卡路里（测量食物含多少热量的单位）

ex.s: Tracking of 150 biochemicals in food has been important in revealing the relationships between calories, sugar, fat and the occurrence of common diseases.
ex.t: 对食物中150种生化物质的追踪在揭示卡路里、糖、脂肪与常见疾病发生之间的关系方面发挥了重要作用。

ex.s: They consumed a bit more calories.
ex.t: 他们消耗了稍多一点的卡路里。

ex.s: After you exercise, you continue to burn calories throughout the day.
ex.t: 运动后，你一整天都会持续燃烧卡路里。

ex.s: Food high in calories may generates positive (3) also make us feel better.
ex.t: 高热量的食物可能产生积极的（3），也让我们感觉更好。

ex.s: It has a digital display that records your steps, speed and distance, as well as monitoring your heart rate and calories burnt.
ex.t: 它有一块数字显示屏，记录你的步数、速度和距离，还能监测心率和消耗的卡路里。

ex.s: It’s good for your heart and you'll burn a lot of calories without going anywhere!
ex.t: 它对心脏有益，而且你足不出户就能消耗大量卡路里！

ex.s: And in America, people who receive 25% of their daily calories or more through sugar are twice as likely to die from heart disease than people who receive less than 10% a day (Journal of the American Medical Association, 2014).
ex.t: 在美国，每天从糖中获取25%或以上热量的人，死于心脏病的可能性是每天摄入不到10%者的两倍（《美国医学会杂志》，2014）。

defs.def: a unit for measuring a quantity of heat; the amount of heat needed to raise the temperature of a gram of water by one degree Celsius 卡，卡路里（热量单位，或 1 克水升高 1 摄氏度时所需要的热量）

ex.s: But as we’ve reshaped the world around us, dramatically reducing the cost and effort involved in obtaining calories, we still have the same brains we had thousands of years ago, and this mismatch is at the heart of why so many of us struggle to resist tempting foods that we know we shouldn’t eat.
ex.t: 但是，当我们重塑周围的世界、大幅降低了获取卡路里所需的成本与精力时，我们仍拥有和数千年前一样的头脑，而这种错配正是我们许多人……的核心原因。

ex.s: The American Heart Association recommends that we limit ourselves to less than 100–150 calories a day from sugar, which is less than what is usually contained in one can of sweet drink or in a single candy bar.
ex.t: 美国心脏协会建议我们把每天从糖中摄取的热量限制在100–150卡路里以下，这少于一罐甜饮料或一块糖果通常所含的量。
